feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 3 September 2026 9:58pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 03 September 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the south of Iceland as a frontal wave gradually clears the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6, increasing 5 to 7 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, occasionally rough in the east tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Rain, heavy at times in the south, clearing tomorrow morning to isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in the east at first, backing west or southwest 3 to 5 Saturday morning, backing south later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon becoming slight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, soon becoming fair.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.
